def analyze(g,bg,cell,label):
    g=np.array(g); mask=g!=bg
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    L=lab[cell]
    comps={}
    from collections import Counter
    pats=Counter()
    info={}
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
        s=(lab[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]==i)
        p=tuple(map(tuple,s))
        pats[p]+=1
        info[i]=dict(col=int(g[ys[0],xs[0]]),pat=p,n=int(len(ys)),cells=set(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist())),
                     bbox=(int(ys.min()),int(xs.min()),int(ys.max()),int(xs.max())))
    tgt=info[L]
    print("===",label,"changed color",tgt['col'],"dupcount",pats[tgt['pat']])
    uniq=[c for c in info.values() if pats[c['pat']]==1 and c is not tgt]
    # nearest uniq by min manhattan cell distance
    def mind(a,b):
        return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in a['cells'] for y2,x2 in b['cells'])
    for c in sorted(uniq,key=lambda c: mind(c,tgt))[:4]:
        print("   uniq shape color",c['col'],"size",c['n'],"bbox",c['bbox'],"dist",mind(c,tgt))
    print("   --- all shapes:")
    for c in sorted(info.values(),key=lambda c:c['bbox']):
        print("   col",c['col'],"n",c['n'],"bbox",c['bbox'],"dups",pats[c['pat']])
